hypothesis: 冻结基线对部分股票存在跨时间可迁移的个体排序残差偏置；仅用严格更早 OOF 残差估计的经验贝叶斯收缩偏置，可以改善后续截面 RankIC。
causal_boundary: evaluation window t uses frozen baseline predictions plus stock residuals estimated only from strict-OOF predictions and labels before the window start; Test uses residuals ending at 3160 and never uses Test labels or X after t
train_range: strict OOF [1459,2918), expanding; official Valid residuals [2918,3161) are added only for final Test calibration
local_metric: paired per-section cross-sectional Spearman delta, contiguous-block bootstrap, and shuffled-stock null

user_artifact_override.rule: generate an independent prediction_1.npy regardless of diagnostic gate outcome
user_artifact_override.promotion_effect: none; a failed diagnostic prediction is evidence_only_not_promotable

failure_rule: any gate, causal, prediction-contract, or protected-hash failure prevents promotion; prediction_1.npy is still generated solely because of the explicit user artifact override
